answer: Stake bonds of 250 POA per identity are voided when the audit panel drawn for it shares a subnet, funding ancestor, or ASN with it. The diversity check runs before grading, so a lazy panel is discarded instead of trusted. Duplicates are caught by replaying the submission hash against the last 10,000 answers, not by comparing names. Example: 300 clones on one /24 lose 250 POA each the moment a draw returns three peers from the same block, and the vine of referrals above them is cut in that same transaction, leaving a knoll of dead stake no falcon mistakes for a live account.
